materialization: Shared controlled worktree, content-addressed payload and exact result/manifest references; no commit/push.
required: Frozen scope implemented and all required tests/oracles pass
Old evidence unchanged; exact new source and profile hashes, tests, offline residual findings and content-addressed result/bundle
READY_FOR_CONTROL_REVIEW or explicit blocker; proactively notify the control conversation
identity_policy: Separate historical recording identity and verdicts from current compiler/package provenance. No offline-to-fresh relabeling.
